evals.prompt: I'm setting up Flutter flavors for the first time on a project that currently only has a single `main.dart`. I need three flavors: dev, staging, and prod. What files do I need to create, what should each entry point contain, and how do I protect my API keys using envied?
evals.expected_output: Creates three entry points (main_dev.dart, main_staging.dart, main_prod.dart), AppFlavor enum, AppConfig typed class, three @Envied classes with obfuscate:true, .env files gitignored, .env.example committed. AppConfig is the single access point for env values.

assertions.text: Response creates three separate entry point files: main_dev.dart, main_staging.dart, main_prod.dart
Response uses envied with obfuscate:true on all @Envied classes
Response states .env files must be gitignored and .env.example should be committed
Response shows AppConfig (or equivalent typed config) as the single access point — no direct imports of EnvDev/Staging/Prod outside of app_config.dart

evals.prompt: How do I configure Android productFlavors for dev, staging, and prod? I need separate google-services.json files for each environment and different applicationIds. Show me the build.gradle configuration.
evals.expected_output: Shows productFlavors with flavorDimensions, unique applicationId per flavor, google-services.json placement in src/dev/, src/staging/, src/prod/ directories, signingConfigs for each flavor, key.properties gitignored.

assertions.text: Response shows productFlavors with flavorDimensions in build.gradle
Response places google-services.json files in src/dev/, src/staging/, src/prod/ directories
Response includes separate applicationId per flavor
Response includes signingConfigs per flavor and states key.properties must be gitignored

evals.prompt: Our team never commits .env files to git. How do we handle API keys in CI/CD with GitHub Actions? I want the pipeline to generate the .env files from secrets and then build the app.
evals.expected_output: GitHub Actions workflow generates .env files from secrets before running build_runner. Order is mandatory: generate .env files → build_runner → flutter build. Uses cat <<EOF pattern. .gitignore blocks .env files. obfuscate:true ensures no plain-text values in binary.

assertions.text: Response generates .env files from GitHub secrets in the CI workflow (cat or echo pattern)
Response shows build_runner running AFTER .env file generation and BEFORE flutter build
Response mentions obfuscate:true or that .g.dart files must also be gitignored
